name: Dekiai Wedding ~Wake Ari Tsuma wa Aisaresugite Nigerarenai~
original_name: 溺愛ウェディング～ワケあり妻は愛されすぎて逃げられない～
source:
You’re just you…
Until one day you’re not.

Now you’re wed to a hot CEO?!

His morning kisses are dizzyingly sweet.
So is what he whispers in bed.

You’re living your very best life, adored by your sexy husband.

You’ve got it all, newlywed!
But will it all end, when he learns your secret?

“I’ll never let you go, my blushing bride.”

Your sweet but messy marriage starts now!
